name: Vercel
shortDescription: Hosting platform with preview environments, instant rollbacks, and Edge Runtime.
description: We frequently host on Vercel for its excellent developer experience, preview environments, instant rollbacks, built-in firewall capabilities, and Edge Runtime.
Vercel’s serverless and edge primitives pair well with our frameworks (SvelteKit, Vue/Nuxt, Astro) for globally fast delivery.
useCases: Preview deployments for every pull request
Global CDN delivery with instant rollbacks
